findings.subject: The entry marker is week-level, so it covers only the first week back

evidence.mechanism: Once any exercise in use holds a state, the marker ends. From then on, an exercise with no state takes the normal first-establishment dose (strengthCandidate: `!ex&&entryWeek` no longer applies), whatever its history before the break. It is not held to the entry dose or the D49 steps.
evidence.P8: W-D49 arm A (F14, no strength before a 25-day break). Week 4: runs and the day-0 strength session done as prescribed; the day-4 session not done. Week 5: glute-bridge 2x8@3 BODYWEIGHT, reverse-lunge 2x10@3 BODYWEIGHT and db-biceps-curl 2x10@3 FIRST_ESTABLISH (never executed, before or after the break). Only dead-bug (executed) is in the return steps, at 1x8@3 RETURN_STEP. FREEZE-5 gives the same doses for those rows.
evidence.P9: T43's own arm A, where the client leaves the chosen loads out. The loaded rows executed in the entry week are not set up (D52), and they stay FIRST_ESTABLISH 2x8@3 in weeks 5 and 6, identical to FREEZE-5. Only bodyweight rows take return step 2. T43's title says the exercises 'take return step 2', but its week-5 bound (sets <= strengthEntrySets + 1 = 2, RIR >= 3) is also met by FIRST_ESTABLISH 2x8@3, so it does not separate the two paths.
evidence.P10: The same arm A with a usable load logged: every row takes return step 2 in week 5, then 3x8 KNOWN and 3x10 KNOWN. FREEZE-5 gave 4x8 in week 5. The correction works when the entry week establishes every exercise.
evidence.probes: probes/qre-p5-paths.mjs; outputs in probes/QRE_P5_PATHS_CANDIDATE.out.json and QRE_P5_PATHS_FREEZE5.out.json, P8 to P10
evidence.authorityText: AUTHORIZATION_PHASE5 §1 and PREREG-8 Δ47: 'um exercício planejado e nunca executado antes da pausa entra na dose de entrada, segue os passos da D49'. Read strictly, the skipped day-4 exercises do not follow D49. Read as D55 ('an exercise first set up while an exercise in use is in the return steps ... rises at most one set per executed week'), they may be compliant. That ruling belongs to SSCTR, and disclosure 2 asks it only for the no-usable-load path, not for a skipped session.

findings.smallestChange: If SSCTR rules the P8/P9 doses inside D49/D55: none (a disclosed residual for the holdout judges). If it rules them outside: no narrow change exists. The one-line candidate (end the marker only when every non-practice exercise in use holds a state) has side effects. A loaded row that is never logged with a load would repeat RETURN_ENTRY indefinitely. It would also suppress rotation (slotEntries) indefinitely. It would change the D52 path that disclosure 2 describes. A correct fix needs an exercise-level entry state, with T42-T47, mutation and differential re-run. Under AUTHORIZATION_PHASE5 that would close R7-D NOT_READY with this blocker named.

findings.subject: The P06 twin of QRE-P4-H02 drops some units without listing them
findings.evidence: properties-9 p06 check(): a capped run on or after the decision's own date that the step's record reports is removed from `runs`. It is listed as P06_SESSION_REPORTED_BY_THIS_DECISION only when no run of that week is left. When later runs of the week remain (a mid-week review reporting that day's run), the reported session's unit disappears with no NOT_EVALUABLE entry. That falls short of the letter of PREREG-8 Δ48 ('volta como NOT_EVALUABLE'). Measured on DEV-9 (probes/QRE_P5_K03_UNITS_DEV9.out.json): 0 such drops, and 0 HARNESS-8 violations dropped without a listing. basis: The question is added only inside the existing trigger: facts' start EASY, no completed run in the 30-day window, elapsed unreported runs outside a stated break. It also requires a CONDITIONAL_PLAN projected start in EASY mode whose credit reading plans a longer run.
It is answerable, and it is not repeated after an answer:
P4a, every listed session reported done: VALID, no question at the next review.
P4b, every listed session reported not done: VALID with the zero reading, no question.
T46: a stated break, a known miss and a reported run in the window ask nothing.
An empty review re-sent an hour later asks the same question with the same 13 run sessions (P5). That is an unanswered question persisting, not repetition.
The question lists only run sessions, and never a reported one (P03 QUESTION_ASKS_ABOUT_REPORTED_SESSION unit, validation 9).
With no run left to plan, creditDecides cannot fire, because it compares only the planned week's runs.
Whether this is the SSCTR-SD-R7C-r2 semantics is SSCTR's ruling; it matches P03(d) as registered.

5.basis: The replaced assertion required FIRST_ESTABLISH, which is the defect itself (CND-2). The new one is stricter on the entry: RETURN_ENTRY at strengthEntrySets with RIR >= strengthEntryMinimumRir, never a KNOWN load. It fails on FREEZE-5 (P5-M1 and P5-M2 kill it). No other existing test changed, which freeze-r7d-6.mjs enforces.

k03.h03: H03 is a re-measurement, not an unread unit. The carriers now compare at a probe one minute after the answer, then at the author's later steps, so a corrected carrier unit can PASS or FAIL on a new corpus. That is a correct measurement, not a conversion of a NOT_EVALUABLE into approval, because no Phase 4 unit is re-graded (PREREG-8 Δ48; K03_PHASE4_UNITS.json is a development reading). Sensitivity is kept: two carrier rows reproduced, and W-CARRIER9/9b and W-HOLD9 fire.
k03.limitation: The K03 reading of the three Phase 4 units (F07, F21, F12) was not re-run here, because the dispatch forbids re-grading final/ cases. DEV-63, DEV-64 and DEV-65 reproduce the three mechanisms, and validation 9 was reproduced on them.
